name: Browser Takeover
description: Connect QwenPaw to Chrome through the local browser bridge for live browser control.
author: QwenPaw

capabilities.title: Chrome bridge
capabilities.description: Connects the Chrome extension to QwenPaw through Native Messaging.

capabilities.title: Browser takeover
capabilities.description: Lets approved agent actions inspect pages and control selected tabs.

capabilities.title: Human approval
capabilities.description: Routes sensitive browser actions through QwenPaw approval checks.

steps.title: Install the Chrome extension
steps.description: Install or load the QwenPaw browser bridge extension in Chrome.

steps.title: Register Native Messaging
steps.description: Create the local Native Messaging host and bridge config files.

steps.title: Connect Chrome
steps.description: Open Chrome and wait for the extension to connect to QwenPaw.
